tasks.subject: CK3: fold data-valued module.ATTR reads into _fingerprint_function (H6/T4)
tasks.description:
**Finding 12 (HIGH) = #73 H6 / T4.** _fingerprint_function folds only names in __globals__ (fingerprint.py:121-124); for `x * cfg.SCALE`, co_names has 'cfg' (a module, canon = module(name) only) and 'SCALE' (not in __globals__), so SCALE's VALUE never enters the digest -> module-attr value change served stale. Fix: disassemble the code object to pair LOAD_ATTR against a module-typed global, and fold the canonicalized VALUE of getattr(module, attr) when it is freezable data (int/float/str/array/...); skip attributes that are functions/ufuncs/modules (stable references, not frozen data -> _Unfingerprintable caught and skipped, formula stays cacheable). Shared walker -> also fixes builder's compile_kernel path. Adversarial verify: must not make np.sqrt-using formulas uncacheable, must re-key on cfg.SCALE change.

tasks.subject: CK1: self-cached formula -> unit uncacheable + warn + document
tasks.description:
**Findings 1,2,8,9,13 (HIGH), conservative approach.** A user @njit(cache=True) Dispatcher (or a DUFunc with cache=True) keeps its own numba cache keyed by the flag/global-blind _index_key; the fresh outer links AND serializes the stale inner binary = permanent poisoning. numbox cannot cure numba's inner cache but can refuse to compound it. Fix in _compile: when any formula in the unit carries its own on-disk cache (Dispatcher/DUFunc whose targetoptions.get('cache') is truthy; CFunc already uncacheable at :125), set cacheable=False (opts['cache']=False), warnings.warn a branded message naming the formula, and proceed (correct via always-recompile; no numbox-owned stale artifact). Document the limitation (see CK7). Do NOT re-wrap py_func (no semantic change). Detection helper likely in compile_kernel or a small utils function.
